title: QC Engineer
description: We are looking for a ​QC Engineer​ in support to our client Fusion for Energy for their location in ​Barcelona, Spain or Cadarache, France​. Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at interview stage). The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: Review suppliers’ quality related documents; Provide support to supervisions and audits performed to suppliers; Follow up of Non-Conformities and deviations (deviations are changes in the requirement of the contract); Establish a close communication with suppliers, being supportive achieving a smooth progress of the activities; Supervise and inspect the manufacturing processes of mechanical components at the suppliers; Support to the definition, qualification and monitoring of joining techniques (Machining, Welding, Assembly) of various components (materials such as stainless steel, copper, aluminum, etc.); Monitoring of non-destructive tests carried out in suppliers, including Ultrasound and Radiography. At ATG Science & Engineering S.L., we are firmly committed to equal opportunities and respect for diversity. The Equality Plan and active policies promote to foster an inclusive environment, free from discrimination. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap (+33% certificado de discapacidad) or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment . Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet these mandatory requirements . If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. Bachelor’s degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, aerospace, or nuclear engineering (or equivalent); At least 5 years of experience in the manufacturing domain, with involvement in QA and QC activities and experience in supplier supervision/audit; Proven experience in: Quality, Audits, and QA procedures; Knowledge of quality control (primarily welding and NDT -RT, UT); Ability to work both autonomously and in a team; Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the EU; Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
